name: vyybe
description: Turn ideas into on-brand marketing visuals — carousels, posts, stories, YouTube thumbnails, ads — edit them in the chat and download PNG, JPG or PDF.

interface.shortDescription: On-brand social & marketing visuals, made in chat
interface.longDescription: Vyybe turns your ideas into polished Instagram and LinkedIn carousels, posts, stories, YouTube thumbnails and ad creatives. It remembers your branding, lets you pick a style visually, and opens an in-chat studio where you can edit text, colors and layout and download PNG, JPG, PDF or ZIP. Everything stays on your computer.
defaultPrompt: Make a 6-slide Instagram carousel about how I use AI to plan my week
Design 3 YouTube thumbnail options for my video "I quit my job to build in public"
Set up my branding from my website
